headline: US September Trade Deficit Narrows as Imports Hit Record High
summary: The US trade deficit decreased by 0.7 percent to $105.0 billion in September, even as overall imports reached a record high.
why: International trade balances provide critical data on economic demand, cross-border flows, and GDP components for the world's largest economy.

impacts.name: US Dollar
impacts.why: Trade balance figures influence foreign exchange demand and macroeconomic expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A narrowing trade deficit offers domestic economic indicators that shape foreign exchange and interest rate expectations.
